interface.title: qPCR Model Fitting with MAK2+ (qPCR MAK2 Analyzer)
interface.field: Molecular biology: quantitative PCR data analysis
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and quality control of raw instrument data, then export
interface.what_it_is_for: Fit the MAK2 mechanistic PCR model to each well's fluorescence-vs-cycle curve to estimate the initial template amount (D0) without a standard curve, as a route to absolute quantification. Then check replicate precision and dilution-series linearity and export the batch results. A Copy Number Conversion option is visible in the sidebar but was not exercised in this run.

data.note: I used the sidebar 'Load Example Data' option with two bundled datasets. The first was 'Boggy et al. - Dilution Series' (12 wells, 40 cycles, 6 ten-fold dilutions in duplicate). The second was 'Technical Replicates Study' (reps: 28 wells, 49 cycles, 7 dilutions in quadruplicate). I did not run Rutledge and did not upload any test file. On reps, the batch fit took several minutes, mostly on the F7 wells. The replay's batch fit on reps stalled in Pass 2 before finishing, which is why t6 to t14 are not_confirmed.

screens_never_reached: Bootstrap confidence intervals on D0: no CI control, column or plot appeared in the batch-fit views, and none was in the downloaded CSV. Single-well fit mode (sidebar 'Batch fit all samples' unticked), where the reviewer reports a Bootstrap CI tab, was never opened
A FAIL or flagged-well state in Visualize Individual Fits: every well in Boggy (12/12) and reps (28/28) fitted successfully, so no failed or flagged fit was seen
No-template-control / no-signal flagging result: 'Detecting samples with no signal…' ran, but neither dataset had NTC wells, so the skipped/no-signal well review was never reached
Rutledge dataset results (X5–X6 expected failures): not run because of the action budget and long fit times
Manual Entry data source view: not opened
Manual grouping mode and the Custom dilution factors option: seen in the lists but not chosen

Copy-number conversion outputs (Auto-detect standards, Limited dilution, Manual CF, Single-copy D0) and the Standard Curve / Limited Dilution Calibration sections: the radio options were seen, but no conversion was run
Cache diagnostics expander and the 'Debug: Error Bar Values' expander: not opened
not_done: Quantify uncertainty via bootstrap CIs: not reached. The batch-fit views and CSV show no CI output. The reviewer reports a Bootstrap CI tab in single-well fit mode, which this run did not try, so this goal stopped at per-well R² and replicate SD/CV
Convert D0 to absolute copy numbers: the Copy Number Conversion options were visible in the sidebar but no method was chosen or run

Flag no-template controls or failed fits: the datasets run had no failures (reps F7 still passed, though it badly hurt dilution linearity), so problem groups were only handled by manual exclusion in the dilution analysis

Upload a test file (Boggy.csv / Rutledge.csv / reps.csv): I opened the Upload File view (CSV/XLSX uploader plus optional plate-metadata CSV, screens/087.webp) and the Load Previous Results view (batch_fit_results.xlsx uploader, screens/088.webp), but uploaded nothing because of the action budget
Changing the fitting-window sliders (first cycle floor, cycles before/after max slope) and refitting: not tried
Download Replicate Statistics (CSV) and the plot PNG/zoom toolbar: not exercised
The xlsx download's contents were not read (binary); only the CSV was checked

Switching the dataset first showed a 'Restored previous batch results' toast, and the old Boggy table stayed on screen until I re-ran Batch Fit (screens/048.webp, screens/052.webp). Replicate-analysis tabs also jump back to the first tab on every rerun.
